scientific_identity.split: 056 BLAKE2b-64 canonical-contact 80% train / 20% development record fold
scientific_identity.replicate_semantics: 560101 and 560102 are optimization initializations, not biological replicates
scientific_identity.initialization: 056 finite 1Mb G-original solver states only; 046 is not an initializer

sources.review_note: PRO_REVIEW_RESULTS_056.md and PRO_REVIEW_RESULTS_057.md are absent from main docs; snapshot publication copies were read

initial_states.Swap: swap both copies' complete xyz and corresponding raw_y over the full half-open candidate interval

A.active_coordinates: all raw_y coordinates of both copies on the candidate chromosome
A.fixed_coordinates: all other chromosomes' raw_y plus q/p and exposure
A.objective_wrapper: reassemble full theta for every FG, call original SharedCaptureObjective full G value+gradient, return active raw_y gradient only
A.cache_policy: cache last accepted full theta, full gradient and full components; never substitute 057 candidate cache after coordinates move; never report last trial as endpoint

optimizer.algorithm: small generic-vector SciPy L-BFGS-B runner preserving 056 budget and last-accepted semantics; do not call 056 raw-y+q adapter
optimizer.frozen_q: full q remains bitwise unchanged in immutable base_theta and is never present in optimizer vector

fg_cap.control_reuse: none: within each seed the two candidates affect different chromosomes

terminal_classification.budget_not_converged: 100 FG exhausted with finite last-accepted active gradient >1e-6

training_gate.candidate_pass: J_control-J_swap >= 1e-5 and swap count_nll_normalized <= control count_nll_normalized
training_gate.per_seed_selection: among passing candidates maximize training J_control-J_swap; exact tie by original candidate_order
training_gate.none_passing: seed failure; do not use development score to choose

B.independence: each seed starts from its unaltered 056 endpoint; never consumes A
B.legal_interval_source: contact_model.P_FLOOR and p_from_q; numerical bounds are interior floats satisfying p_from_q(q_from_p(p)) == p exactly

cache.inter: p-invariant but retained in Zall and observed log rate
cache.scalar_objective: count_nll_normalized + original p_prior + fixed physical-regularizer constant; count_constant_raw=K0+diag_profiled_nll_raw
cache.preaggregation: at cache build aggregate Zinter, sum_Cinter_log_rate, Noff, sum_b_all_cis and sum_delta_all_cis; scalar calls retain only positive-count cis arrays and never rescan inter or zero-count cis
cache.physical_constants: reuse trusted source/last-accepted components; no separate repulsion sweep

search.coarse_grid: linear including exact p<->q roundtrip bounds 0.00010000000000000002 and 0.9998999999999998
search.bounded_interval: two neighboring coarse-grid points around the lowest coarse-grid value, clipped to legal interval
search.scalar_call_accounting: count every cache miss, including original/new-p diagnostic value and derivative requests; exact-p cache hits do not increment
search.selection: minimum scalar objective, exact tie favors original p then smaller p
search.stop_label: bounded_profile_numeric_stop only when solver success and finite result; never claim mathematical global optimum
search.failure: nonfinite cache/rate/objective or scalar cap exhaustion stops B for that seed

report: analytic dJ/dp at p_before and p_after
analytic dJ/dq=(dJ/dp)*(dp/dq) at p_before and p_after

branch.no_coordinate_action: finish with 0 coordinate FG; retain and evaluate actual original/profile fixed-x terminal states
branch.coordinate_trigger: otherwise both seeds run both Control and Profile arms
branch.segment_restart: same frozen segment boundaries; restart L-BFGS-B memory at each boundary
branch.Control: source x,p; joint coordinates+p optimization in every segment
branch.Profile: source x; before every segment rebuild fixed-x p cache, profile p, then joint coordinates+p optimization for 50 FG
branch.segment1_reuse: initial diagnostic cache/profile is reused as Profile segment 1; do not rebuild

auxiliary_fullgrid_equivalent_budget.unit: contact full-grid forward=1; full-G value/gradient contact+full-pair repulsion=2; count-only forward=1

worst_case.role: A terminal development plus cis strata, one fused count-only forward per endpoint
B fixed-x p-cache builds, initial two reused for Profile segment1 plus segments2-3
B actual terminal development plus cis strata, one fused count-only forward per endpoint
A train gates and gradients from last-accepted FG cache
validation reserve, unavailable to extra optimization or repeated scoring

auxiliary_fullgrid_equivalent_budget.priority: complete all A endpoints and their evaluation before spending B optional work; never reduce A controls for B

evaluation_gate.precondition: all finite terminal training/selection records and every state, presence mask and export are written and SHA256-frozen before opening raw phase body or reference

development.primary: full development NLL without K0, regularizers, or re-estimated exposure/p
development.single_forward: each endpoint collects global, three cis strata and inter in one contact forward
development.distance_formula: abs(pos_bin_j-pos_bin_i) on the 1Mb full-model grid using true genomic bin-anchor bp; not raw-read bp and not compressed index
development.partition_check: three cis groups' record counts and eligible-pair counts must each sum exactly to all cis off-diagonal counts/pairs
development.group_mass_contribution: (-sum_g C*log(rate)+N_g*log(Zall))/Noff; three cis plus inter must reconstruct global conditional no-K0 NLL
development.within_group_conditional_nll: (-sum_g C*log(rate)+N_g*log(Z_g))/N_g; use each group's own Z_g and record denominator

reference.mapping: for every endpoint and chromosome choose one whole-chromosome best geometric A/B mapping using all frozen-support distances; reuse it for same/cross/contrast/margin and every R1 distance group; no window or group truth flip
reference.swap_return_geometry: in the fixed whole-nucleus coordinate frame, compare affected-chromosome Control and Swap terminal coordinates; allow exactly one whole-chromosome A/B permutation choosing smaller RMSD; no window flip and no rigid/Kabsch/Procrustes alignment
reference.near_control_effect: additional A gate/flag: a near_control Swap is classified as reversion and cannot count as a new switched-chain improvement; it does not alter training candidate selection and does not apply to B

phase_traceability.source_review_before_gate: source code and provenance only; no raw phase rows
phase_traceability.post_gate_alignment: load all raw records, require complete row count and exact seven-column SNP-free identity/coordinate order; apply numeric cis endpoint canonicalization with synchronous phase swap; only then apply the original development fold
phase_traceability.coordinate_adapter: explicitly validate raw genomic bp to zero-based 1Mb full-grid bin anchors; do not inherit pr.paths.OFF or old 3Mb grid assumptions
phase_traceability.direct_label_rule: R1_direct is available only if independent provenance explicitly establishes phase field type/origin as direct SNP calls; column names and unknown values alone are insufficient
phase_traceability.unqualified_rule: if direct versus inferred cannot be distinguished, report R1_direct=NA with reason and exclusion counts; separately report honest label_type
phase_traceability.eligible_records: same-copy cis off-diagonal with both endpoint labels known, using the same bin_anchor_genomic_separation groups
phase_traceability.phase_convention: phase0->pat and phase1->mat only after provenance qualification
phase_traceability.random_copy_control: analytic expectation 0.5 with exact eligible denominator; no Monte Carlo sampling
phase_traceability.reference_coordinate_diagnostic: same support and same one-time chromosome mapping; diagnostic, not a mathematical ceiling

reliable_long_distance_identity.minimum_support: at least 200 qualified direct records and at least 20 distinct canonical (chromosome,bin_i,bin_j) blocks on each evaluated support
reliable_long_distance_identity.effect: within each canonical bin-pair block aggregate total records and paired candidate-minus-Control hit-score sum; report records-weighted delta
reliable_long_distance_identity.uncertainty: 1000 paired canonical-bin-pair block bootstrap resamples with replacement, seed 580201; both arms use the same sampled blocks; report percentile 95% interval
reliable_long_distance_identity.scope: A uses each seed's preselected affected chromosome; B uses all 20 chromosomes together; no truth-driven window flip
reliable_long_distance_identity.reliable_degradation: qualified direct labels, sufficient records/blocks, point estimate <= -0.02, and bootstrap upper 95% bound <0
reliable_long_distance_identity.sample_insufficient_NA: unqualified label provenance, fewer than 200 records, or fewer than 20 distinct bin-pair blocks; do not infer safety
reliable_long_distance_identity.diagnostic_scope: one-cell bin-pair resampling technical diagnostic; not molecule-level or biological replication and no claim that bin-pair blocks are independent
reliable_long_distance_identity.adoption_effect: reliable degradation vetoes adoption; NA does not block non-identity evaluation but requires identity_unverified and forbids an identity-recovery claim

adoption.A: both seeds selected; each dev gain>=0.001; affected-chromosome min_margin delta>=-1e-10; all20 macro same delta>=-0.02; selected Swap must not be near_control; no reliable long-distance direct-identity degradation
adoption.B: both seeds dev gain>=0.001; min_margin delta>=-1e-10; all20 macro same delta>=-0.02; no reliable long-distance direct-identity degradation
adoption.cross_and_contrast: always co-report; never substitute for gates
adoption.optimization_imbalance: A compares active raw-y gradients; B compares full raw-y/q gradients. Flag when one paired arm reaches its relevant gtol and the other exhausts budget, or gradient ratio>10 with either>1e-6
adoption.imbalance_effect: warning/classification only, not an extra veto on the frozen candidate gates; describe as fixed-budget optimization difference, not inherent structure or global optimality. Nonfinite/abnormal stop/mismatched budget makes the pair incomplete and ineligible for a success claim
adoption.claim_limit: training or p improvement alone does not adopt; no baseline replacement and no L2 claim

required_fixture_checks.source_and_swap_initial_G_reproduction: use each arm's first budgeted FG, not an auxiliary call
